Name: Park Tour
Description: Venus Splash Park has finally come back after some maintenance. Check it out!

Name: Casual Walk
Description: Walk on the central square until sunrise. The park slowly wakes up, turning into a wonderland that is isolated from the war.

Name: Shark-speare Statue
Description: Restored by WGAA, this Shark-speare is a statue with no other functions. Even the torn clothes and wounds are perfectly restored.

Name: Dove & Olive
Description: A flock of real and bionic doves is waiting for you. When you feed the real doves, the bionic ones will pick up olive branches and give them to you as a sign of a wish for peace.

Name: Dance Battle
Description: You had a good sweat playing "DanceDanceGo!" with a mysterious online opponent. But when you finish playing, you find that the arcade isn't connected to the network.

Name: Golden Game
Description: "Twin Tail Battleground" is officially launch! Save the power of Moe from this boring world! ...Somehow this name sounds a bit familiar to you.

Name: Zevious BX
Description: A modern HD remake of a vintage game. Once you score over 999999990, you will gain infinite life. Why haven't they fixed this bug after adding so many new elements?

Name: Flea Market
Description: Restored to a flea market during the Golden Age that gives visitors a bargaining experience. Successful bargainers will receive out-of-commerce items from the Golden Age, including...

Name: Martini
Description: Martini, gin, no absinthe or vodka. Stir, but don't shake. — The bar no longer sells alcohol drinks, but you placed an order following the movie scripts anyway. The result is a glass of apple juice.

Name: Swimwear Sale
Description: One-piece, high-waisted, ruffle, bikini, wetsuit... all types of swimwear are available here. The human and Construct sections are separated, but they share the same fitting room.

Name: Coffee Bar
Description: Located near the Go Shark Go station, you can present your dating pass for 2 Shark-special drinks—which are just salted caramel latte.

Name: Dating Pass
Description: This special pass for two can unlock unlimited rides of Go Shark Go and the Ferris wheel. You can enter the Ferris wheel directly via the tower along the rail.

Name: Go Shark Go
Description: This is supposed to be a roller coaster, but has no thrilling mechanism. It almost seems that the designer only wants two guests to enjoy a relaxing ride around the park.

Name: Shark-Attack
Description: Nobody knows why a spook house was built near the aquarium. You must survive the great white shark escape to arrive at the normal aquarium.

Name: Silver Curtain
Description: The fish around the restored underwater tunnel haven't seen visitors for years. They have formed a silver curtain around the tunnel's outer wall.

Name: Jellyfish Sticker
Description: Small moon jellyfish stickers can be found in every hidden corner. Rumor has it that those who collect all different angles of moon jellyfish can win a grand prize. Who put the stickers there in the first place though?

Name: Grand Blue Sea
Description: The large "Grand Blue" text on the Ferris wheel reminds the guests that they can have the best view of the sea here.

Name: Eye of Venus
Description: Despite its capacity of up to six visitors per capsule, each one admits only two visitors. When the capsule reaches the highest point, there will be a power shortage for nearly an hour.

Name: Above the Clouds
Description: You board this gift-shaped hot air balloon originally designed for marriage proposals. Its slogan is "Propose to your loved one 35,000 feet in the air! We also provide parachute service if he or she turns you down."

Name: Silver Beach
Description: You walk on the silver beach and pick up a conch from the warm sand. What kind of tale would you hear from it?

Name: Wet & Wild
Description: The waves are great for surfing, so why don't you grab a board and ride on the tide?

Name: Candielicious
Description: You can find this booth right next to the beach. Ice-cream, waffles, caramel donuts... Get all the calories you just burned back immediately—Constructs are an exception.
